nodes.label: Ticket arrives
nodes.detail:
Mail, chat and the web form all open a ticket.
The customer gets an automatic receipt.

nodes.label: Service down?
nodes.detail: Down means the customer cannot log in or a paid feature fails for every user of the account.

nodes.label: Page the on-call engineer
nodes.detail:
Within 15 minutes, day and night.
The engineer owns the ticket until the service is back.

nodes.label: Queue by product
nodes.detail: Billing, account and integrations each have a queue of their own; the first answer is due within one working day.
